about: What this person told voters in each campaign since 2016: their campaign website as saved by the Wayback Machine just before election day (the homepage and the pages about where they stand), as text, and their campaign-season Bluesky and Threads posts. From scripts/collect-campaign-text.mjs; the promises in it are found by step 2.
name: Randy Fine

pages.title: Randy Fine for State Senate
pages.text:
Please enable JavaScript in your browser to complete this form.
## Randy Fine puts
America and Florida First.
- Secure our borders and give the Sheriff the power to arrest illegal immigrants.
- Continue record investments in traffic-reducing projects.
- Lower insurance rates and hold insurance companies accountable.
- Protect elections from fraud.
- Protect the Second Amendment at all costs.
- Counter the effects of inflation and lower prices.
- Fight to defend life.
- Cut property taxes.
- Back the Blue and give first responders the resources they need to keep us safe.
- Restore the Indian River Lagoon.
“Florida State Rep. Randy Fine is a MAGA Warrior who will stand up to anyone to advance the America First agenda! One four only elected Jewish Republicans, he stands with me for an America that brings Peace through Strength, and an Economy that works for our Nation’s families. I need him in the Florida Senate, and he has my Complete and Total Endorsement!”
